document_title: Aster Regional Bank — Fraud Relief Bluebook
text:
1 About this guide
This guide explains how Aster Regional Bank handles relief payments for victims of transfer fraud (furikome sagi) under the Act on Relief Payments for Victims of Fraudulent Transfers. It is written for applicants. It explains the process only. It does not decide whether you will receive a payment or how much. Decisions are made by the bank after the steps below.

document_title: Aster Regional Bank — Fraud Relief Bluebook
text:
2 Who can apply
You can apply if you transferred money because of fraud to an account that has since been frozen. Examples are calls from someone pretending to be a relative, the police or a government office, fake investment offers, and fake prize or refund notices. You can also apply on behalf of a family member with their written consent.

document_title: Aster Regional Bank — Fraud Relief Bluebook
text:
3.1 Documents you need
To apply to Aster Regional Bank you need:
- the completed Relief Application Form (Form AR-7)
- a copy of your photo ID (driving licence, My Number card or passport)
- the transfer receipt or bank statement showing the payment
- the police report receipt number Copies are fine unless a certified copy is stated. We return original documents by registered mail.

document_title: Aster Regional Bank — Fraud Relief Bluebook
text:
3.2 How and when to contact us
Call the relief desk at 0120-111-701 (weekdays from 9:00 to 17:00, except national holidays and 29 December to 3 January). Postal address: Aster Regional Bank, Fraud Relief Desk, 1-2-3 Kita, Sapporo. Calls are free from landlines and mobile phones.
section: 3.2 How and when to contact us

document_title: Aster Regional Bank — Fraud Relief Bluebook
text:
4.1 Verification
After we receive your application, we check that it is complete and that the transfer matches our records. If something is missing, we contact you by phone or letter. Verification usually takes two to four weeks. You do not need to do anything during verification unless we contact you.

document_title: Aster Regional Bank — Fraud Relief Bluebook
text:
4.2 After verification
After verification, the bank checks the recipient account and freezes any remaining balance. The applicant is contacted only if further documents are required.

document_title: Aster Regional Bank — Fraud Relief Bluebook
text:
4.3 Public notice period
The public notice runs for 60 days. During those 60 days, anyone who claims the money in the account may come forward. If nobody claims the money, the account holder's rights end and the remaining balance can be used for relief payments.

document_title: Aster Regional Bank — Fraud Relief Bluebook
text:
4.4 Payment notice and application period
After the notice period, a payment notice is published. You must apply within 30 days after the payment notice is published. If you already applied before the payment notice, you do not need to apply again.

document_title: Aster Regional Bank — Fraud Relief Bluebook
text:
5.1 How the amount is decided
The money available is only what remained in the frozen account. If several victims sent money to the same account, the remaining balance is shared in proportion to each victim's loss. The payment may be less than the amount you lost, and it may be nothing if the account was empty. Staff cannot tell you the amount before the decision.

document_title: Aster Regional Bank — Fraud Relief Bluebook
text:
5.2 When you receive the payment
Payment is made within 30 days after the bank decides the amount. The payment goes to the bank account you named in your application. We send a decision letter before paying.

document_title: Aster Regional Bank — Fraud Relief Bluebook
text:
6 If your details change
Tell us as soon as possible if your address, phone number or payment account changes. You can also withdraw your application at any time by telling the relief desk in writing.

document_title: Aster Regional Bank — Fraud Relief Bluebook
text:
7 If you disagree with the decision
You may ask for a review within 14 days of receiving the decision letter. Send a short letter explaining why you disagree to the Fraud Relief Desk.
section: 7 If you disagree with the decision

document_title: Aster Regional Bank — Fraud Relief Bluebook
text:
8 Video consultation
Aster Regional Bank offers video consultations with a relief officer on a tablet at any Aster branch. Book a 30-minute slot by phone. Video consultation is free and available in Japanese only.

document_title: Aster Regional Bank — Fraud Relief Bluebook
text:
9 Protect yourself from new scams
Aster Regional Bank will never ask you to pay a fee to receive a relief payment, and will never ask for your PIN or online-banking password. If someone calls about your relief payment and asks for money, hang up and call 0120-111-701.
